issues.description: revoke_error exposed via API may leak sensitive backend details
issues.detail: RevokeErr originates from arbitrary backend revocation failures and routinely contains connection strings, internal hostnames, credentials, or stack traces. Exposing it verbatim through lease lookup broadens the audience from operator logs to any caller with lookup permission. The PR author flagged this concern. Gate behind sudo capability or redact to a generic indicator with details only in logs.

issues.description: Breaking rename of exported FetchLeaseTimes method without deprecation shim
issues.detail: FetchLeaseTimes is an exported method on ExpirationManager. Renaming to FetchLeaseInfo with no alias breaks any external consumer, plugin, or fork importing vault as a library. Keep FetchLeaseTimes as a thin wrapper delegating to FetchLeaseInfo, marked deprecated, to preserve backward compatibility for at least one release cycle.

issues.description: OpenAPI declares 'path' as Required but handler may emit empty values
issues.detail: logical_system_paths.go marks the new 'path' response field as Required: true, yet the handler always writes leaseEntry.Path regardless of value. Older persisted leases or token/auth leases may have empty Path, producing responses that violate the schema contract. Either drop Required, or guarantee Path is always populated on persisted entries.

issues.description: Test coverage missing for new namespace_path and revoke_error fields
issues.detail: logical_system_test.go only asserts the new 'path' field. The two other headline additions (namespace_path, revoke_error) have no test coverage, so regressions in namespace or RevokeErr propagation through leaseInfoForExport would go undetected. Add at minimum a namespace_path assertion for a non-root NS and a revoke_error assertion after a forced revocation failure.

issues.description: Inconsistent context usage in renamed test (t.Context() vs nil)
issues.detail: TestExpiration_revokeEntry_rejected_fairsharing was changed to namespace.RootContext(t.Context()) while sibling sites in the same file still use namespace.RootContext(nil). The mixed style conflates an unrelated context refactor with a pure rename and invites confusion. Either migrate all sites consistently or revert this site to keep the diff minimal.

issues.description: Metric label 'expire.fetch-lease-times' retained after rename without comment
issues.detail: FetchLeaseInfo still emits metrics.MeasureSince with the key 'expire.fetch-lease-times'. Preserving the label is correct for dashboard continuity, but without a code comment a future cleanup may 'fix' the inconsistency and silently break operator metrics. Add a brief comment documenting the intentional mismatch.

synthesis.summary: The PR cleanly renames FetchLeaseTimes to FetchLeaseInfo and threads three new fields (path, namespace_path, revoke_error) through the lease lookup response. The panel unanimously flags two concerns that should block merge: the security exposure of revoke_error (which routinely carries backend connection strings and credentials) to any caller with lookup permission, and the breaking rename of an exported method without a deprecation shim. Secondary concerns include an OpenAPI schema declaring 'path' Required while the handler can emit empty values, and missing test coverage for namespace_path and revoke_error. The change is small and focused, but the security and API-compatibility decisions need explicit resolution before landing.
